usage: nucleus_competitive_split.py [-h] [--arm ARM] [--param PARAM]
                                    [--seg-override SEG_OVERRIDE]
                                    [--bbox BBOX BBOX BBOX BBOX BBOX BBOX]
                                    [--nuclei-h5 NUCLEI_H5] --out-name
                                    OUT_NAME [--factor FACTOR]
                                    [--min-nucleus-share MIN_NUCLEUS_SHARE]
                                    [--block BLOCK] [--report REPORT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --arm ARM
  --param PARAM         param JSON to take AFF_PATH/convention/keep-mask from
                        (default: the arm's own)
  --seg-override SEG_OVERRIDE
                        segmentation layer, if not the param's SEG_PATH
  --bbox BBOX BBOX BBOX BBOX BBOX BBOX
                        restrict to this bbox instead of the param's BBOX
  --nuclei-h5 NUCLEI_H5
                        override the nucleus mask
  --out-name OUT_NAME   name of the new precomputed layer
  --factor FACTOR       pooling for the flood
  --min-nucleus-share MIN_NUCLEUS_SHARE
                        a nucleus counts as present in a segment only if the
                        segment holds at least this share of THAT nucleus's
                        whole mask
  --block BLOCK
  --report REPORT
